pictures.viewed: Actually inspected 1024x576 aerial: asymmetric connected rear wings, open yellow-walled rear court, long roof skylights, shallow central stone dome/attic and five stepped curved glass pavilion bands. Terrace/garden/fountain surrounds are context; court size/position reconstructed rather than map-measured.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Connected Brooklyn Museum exterior: exact parent/part footprint, long pale Beaux-Arts wings and rear ranges, picture-led open rear court, six-column Ionic portico/recessed upper doorway, supported triangular pediment and abstract relief/roof ornament, square attic and shallow stone dome, flat roof/skylights and the curved stepped glass entrance pavilion. Pavilion has a real central recessed lower door, soffit and threshold; glass is an opaque reflected exterior proxy. Outer terraced landscape, fountains, garden collections, temporary exhibition banners, freestanding art, furnished rooms and copied sculpture/inscriptions remain outside this model.
